verdict.rationale: A system-to-system filing channel is a fair question for a state corporate registry, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only human-facing channels: PDF forms submitted by upload, fax or mail, and a keyless franchise-tax portal protected by an image CAPTCHA. Registered agents are described as the de facto service layer, but no documented system-account, transmitter or batch-provider program or enrollment path is published, and all probed OpenAPI paths return 404.
